verdict.rationale: The business plans document that incoming calls can ring multiple numbers at once (simultaneous) or roll to different numbers when the first isn't answered (sequential, overflow to another number). Advanced call routing, call forwarding, shared team numbers and voicemail with transcription are also documented. missing for 10: explicit documentation that unanswered calls fall through to voicemail, detailed configuration docs for ring groups and ring order, and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond marketing pages.
